name: object-spy-playwright
description: Drive a real, visible Chrome window via CDP, spy on page objects with hover-to-highlight, generate short relative Playwright locators (XPath/CSS) with live uniqueness scoring, and emit enterprise-grade Playwright automation code in Java or Python.
author: WenYi Tan, Alicia Loh, Gaurav Misra

objectSpy.cdpPort.description: Chrome remote debugging port. The extension attaches to an already-running Chrome on this port, or launches a new Chrome process with it. Bound to localhost/127.0.0.1 only — treat this port as sensitive: anything with access to it has full control of the browser session.

objectSpy.chromeExecutablePath.description: Path to the Chrome (or Edge) executable to launch. Leave blank to auto-detect the system installation.

objectSpy.useRealChromeProfile.description: When launching a new Chrome process, point --user-data-dir at your real default Chrome profile so existing logins/sessions are available. NOTE: recent Chrome versions block remote debugging on the actual default profile directory for security reasons — if this fails, Chrome will need a copy of your profile directory instead. When this setting is off, a separate dedicated automation profile is used.

objectSpy.userDataDir.description: Custom --user-data-dir to launch Chrome with. Leave blank to auto-detect (real profile path when 'Use Real Chrome Profile' is on, otherwise a dedicated temp profile).

objectSpy.startUrl.description: URL to open when Chrome is launched/attached.
